description:
Create a new Agentled workflow from an n8n JSON import.

Behavior:
- runs deterministic import preview
- creates workflow in preflight draft mode
- stores imported contract for review/approval
- does NOT auto-apply scaffold

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

n8nJson.description: n8n workflow JSON object or string export

workflow.description: Optional metadata overrides for the created workflow

name: import_n8n_workflow
